items.title: 68436_Alberta Hunter oral history interview
items.q: a lot of those songs that Lovey had, I was in on them... she was so good about having my 'Downhearted Blues' copy written and all, and was so honest about it

ctx.x: Song writers would come to me, and in the meantime I wrote a whole lot of different songs myself. And a lot of those songs that Lovey had, I was in on them, but I didn't claim anything on them because she was so good about having my "Downhearted Blues" copy written and all, and was so honest about it, you know. And then I wasn't money crazy anyway. I just thought to make an honest living was the best thing to do, you know.
